h2: Bodmin Plumbing Services is a Leeds based company,
paragraphs: From central heating systems to boiler servicing and upgrades…
We can install washing machines and dishwashers to new build regulations…
All gas appliances must be installed in accordance with current gas safety…
We cover contract, insurance and private work. We fully guarantee all our work and are fully insured with Corgi. We offer 24 hr call out services for DIY disasters and water leaks.
We are also a Which? Trusted Trader.
With so many plumbing and heating companies about its not always easy to choose a reliable one, with over 30 years of experience Bodmin Plumbing Services is a family run business.
We offer discounts on all our services for OAP’s.
Most of our work is from recommendation from satisfied customers.
For more information about our services please browse our website or contact us.
